title: NGU Idle adventure zone reference
purpose: Offline reference only; not runtime configuration or verified combat safety thresholds.

coverage.equipmentAndOtherDrops: Selected equipment groups and notable drops; not an exhaustive loot simulator.
coverage.enemyStats: Partial: Adventure-tab stats only, never Boss Fight attack/defense. Empty arrays mean not collected, not no enemies.

adventureOverview.supports: Zone order, recommendations, idle interpretation, cube-root loot scaling from Chocolate World.

titans.supports: Titan names, sequence and difficulty-specific boss unlocks; combat/loot intentionally excluded.

skills.supports: Idle damage multipliers 1.2/1.5/1.8 and Beast Mode effects.

localZoneStats.supports: Game zone IDs for regular zones 0 through 41; comparison with legacy recommendations. Not independent game verification.

localBoostFarm.supports: Regular zone IDs including 43; boost table cross-check. Comment attributes table to Farmer Sanc's Boost Almanac, NGU 1.220; original spreadsheet not retrieved.

localZoneHelpers.supports: Safe zone -1, titan IDs, final titan IDs 44/45. Effective boss IDs in this file are NOT the wiki's difficulty-relative boss numbers.

conventions.zoneId: Game/injector ID, not wiki ordinal. Safe zone is -1; wikiOrdinal = zoneId + 2 for these 47 locations.
conventions.sourceInheritance: All zone fields except zoneId and explicitly separately sourced enemyStats come from that record's sourceUrl, retrieved on the top-level retrievedAt date. Local ID mapping uses the local sources above. Zone pages were fetched with ?action=render.
conventions.recommendationStatus: Community recommendations transcribed from individual zone Fight tables; not actual enemy stats, verified minima, or guarantees. Individual zone pages take precedence over the overview; conflicts are preserved in notes/documentation.
conventions.numberUnits: Unscaled adventure stat points; JSON scientific notation is numeric. Probabilities are fractions in [0,1], not percentages. Displayed wiki units are converted without adding precision.
conventions.null: Unknown, unspecified, uncollected, or unresolved as explained in notes. Never interpret null as zero or safe. An empty enemyStats array means stats not collected.
conventions.beastMode: null = source did not distinguish; false/true = source's OFF/ON recommendation, not an instruction to toggle it.
conventions.idleMeaning: Overview describes toughness to maintain about 90% health and power sufficient to kill exploders. Player HP requirements were not specified in retrieved regular-zone tables and are null throughout.
conventions.oneHitMeaning: Source-listed player power recommendation; attack modifier/sets are not consistently specified. Do not treat as enemy HP or derive enemy stats from it.
conventions.boostChance: Conditional on killing a normal enemy, before player loot modifiers. capChance null means cap not stated in the zone page, not an assumed 100% cap. Duplicate rows are preserved; roll independence is not verified.
conventions.equipmentChance: Chance of the listed group, not each item. selection one_of does not establish equal item weights. null normal/boss chance means no chance transcribed, not proof of no drop.
conventions.equipmentLevels: Base drop levels before challenge/set rewards. baseLevelExceptions overrides baseLevel by exact item name.
conventions.otherDrops: Selected source descriptions retained as strings, not a normalized probability model. Conditions matter. See the zone source for complete loot and independent/conditional roll details.
conventions.enemyStats: Static values from the Adventure tab of linked bestiary pages. attackRate and hpRegen retain wiki labels; their precise timing units have not been independently verified. isZoneBoss is a zone roster classification, distinct from the bestiary Type field.

loot.lootMultiplier: D = displayed total drop-chance percent / 100; baseline 100% gives D = 1.
loot.perListedBoostRow: p = min(capChance, baseChance * D) before Chocolate World; p = min(capChance, baseChance * D^(1/3)) from Chocolate World, where a cap is known.
loot.scope: Interpretation of the wiki's zone-factor formula, cross-checked with localBoostFarm. Not a universal formula for every special, quest, guaranteed or additive-chance drop. Do not cube-root baseChance itself.
loot.unconditionalNormalBoostExpectation: If applicable, expected boosts per arbitrary zone kill = (1 - bossChance.numerator / bossChance.denominator) * sum(p for eligible boost rows). Expected count, not probability of at least one drop; no independence assumption needed for the sum.

idleMultiplierConditions: Spoopy set and all Sadistic No Equipment challenges complete
combat.beastMode: Wiki lists +40% power (+50% with Purple Liquid set), but damage received becomes 300%. Buff/set context must be known before comparing thresholds.
combat.oneHitVerification: Not calculated or game-tested. No enemy HP/toughness values are inferred from recommendations or BoostFarmHelper.OneHitPower.
